project.name: Indian Equity Knowledge System
project.description: Point-in-time equity research knowledge system for NSE/BSE Nifty 50 + Next 50, enforcing deterministic computation (R1), temporal as-of semantics (R2), and LLM-as-hypothesis (R3).

nodes.name: isin.py
nodes.summary: Provides deterministic ISIN validation utilities: a Luhn-algorithm-based check digit calculator and a full ISIN format validator used across parsers.

nodes.name: http.py
nodes.summary: Polite HTTP client that enforces per-host throttling, respects robots.txt, and handles retries with exponential backoff for scraping NSE/BSE data without violating rate limits.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses httpx for async-compatible HTTP; robots.txt is fetched and cached per origin to avoid repeat lookups.

nodes.name: parser.py
nodes.summary: Parses NSE bhavcopy ZIP archives into structured daily equity price records, with per-row ISIN validation and quarantine of malformed or invalid entries.

nodes.name: adapters.py
nodes.summary: Adapters for fetching and loading NSE Indices constituent CSV lists from the live archive and the Wayback Machine CDX API, with full provenance tracking and re-parse support.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements three adapter classes (live, drop-folder, Wayback Machine) sharing common load_list and reparse_stored_lists logic.

nodes.name: parser.py
nodes.summary: Parses NSE Indices constituent CSV files into structured index membership records, validating ISIN format and quarantining malformed rows.

nodes.name: schema.py
nodes.summary: Defines StrictModel, the base Pydantic class for all ingest schemas, configured to reject unknown fields and catch upstream shape changes loudly.

nodes.name: test_compute_isin.py
nodes.summary: Property-style tests for the ISIN check digit algorithm and full ISIN validator, covering known valid ISINs, malformed inputs, and exact check digit properties.

nodes.name: test_http.py
nodes.summary: Comprehensive tests for PoliteClient covering per-host throttling, robots.txt handling, retry behavior on 429/503, Retry-After header parsing, and raw byte transfer.

nodes.name: test_nse_bhavcopy_parser.py
nodes.summary: Tests for the NSE bhavcopy ZIP parser, covering CSV extraction, row validation, ISIN checks, malformed data quarantine, and trade date parsing.

nodes.name: test_nse_indices_parser.py
nodes.summary: Tests for the NSE Indices constituent list parser, covering header detection, row validation, ISIN checks, and quarantine of malformed rows.

nodes.name: test_wayback_cdx.py
nodes.summary: Tests for Wayback CDX parsing and run_boundaries deduplication, covering CDX shape validation, capture parsing, and run boundary detection.

nodes.name: isin_check_digit
nodes.summary: Computes the Luhn-algorithm check digit for an 11-character ISIN body, raising ValueError for input that does not match the expected alphanumeric pattern.

nodes.name: is_valid_isin
nodes.summary: Returns True when the input matches the 12-character ISIN format and its check digit is correct.

nodes.name: AccessBlocked
nodes.summary: Exception raised when the polite client detects that access to a URL is blocked by robots.txt or a 403/451 HTTP response.

nodes.name: PoliteClient
nodes.summary: Context-manager HTTP client that enforces per-host request throttling, robots.txt compliance, and exponential backoff retry for transient HTTP errors and timeouts.

nodes.name: _retry_after
nodes.summary: Parses the Retry-After response header value in seconds, returning 0.0 if the header is absent or non-numeric.

nodes.name: _decode
nodes.summary: Decompresses an HTTP response body based on its Content-Encoding header, supporting gzip and zlib (deflate) encodings in last-to-first order.

nodes.name: BhavcopyRawRow
nodes.summary: Pydantic model for a raw bhavcopy CSV row with string fields exactly as received from NSE, before numeric type conversion.

nodes.name: BhavcopyRow
nodes.summary: Validated bhavcopy row with typed numeric fields (Decimal prices, int volumes) and the trade date derived from the file header.

nodes.name: RowIssue
nodes.summary: Records a row-level parse or validation problem, retaining the raw text and reason code for quarantine reporting.

nodes.name: ParsedBhavcopy
nodes.summary: Result container holding the parsed trade date, list of valid BhavcopyRow instances, and any RowIssue quarantine entries.

nodes.name: BhavcopyRejected
nodes.summary: Exception raised when an entire bhavcopy file is rejected due to an unrecoverable structural problem such as a malformed ZIP or missing trade date.

nodes.name: _extract_csv
nodes.summary: Extracts the single CSV file from a bhavcopy ZIP archive, raising BhavcopyRejected if the archive is malformed or contains no CSV entry.

nodes.name: parse_bhavcopy
nodes.summary: Top-level bhavcopy parser that converts raw ZIP bytes into a ParsedBhavcopy result, detecting the trade date, validating ISINs, and quarantining malformed rows.

nodes.name: Tally
nodes.summary: Mutable counter for a constituent list ingest run, tracking raw files, snapshots, quarantine rows, rejected files, and any problems, used to build the final RunResult.

nodes.name: NseIndicesConstituents
nodes.summary: Live adapter that fetches NSE Indices constituent CSV files from the niftyindices.com archive, stores raw bytes, and loads each snapshot with full provenance.

nodes.name: NseIndicesConstituentsDrop
nodes.summary: Drop-folder adapter for NSE Indices constituent CSVs placed manually, used as the fallback when the live archive is blocked or unavailable.

nodes.name: CdxCapture
nodes.summary: Pydantic model for a single Wayback Machine CDX API result row, carrying capture timestamp, original URL, MIME type, HTTP status, and SHA1 digest.

nodes.name: WaybackIndexConstituents
nodes.summary: Adapter that queries the Wayback Machine CDX API for historical constituent list captures, deduplicates runs with identical digests, and loads each unique snapshot with its archived as-of timestamp.

nodes.name: load_list
nodes.summary: Validates and stores a constituent list document into the database, creating IndexSnapshot and IndexSnapshotConstituent rows and quarantining invalid entries.

nodes.name: _link_entities
nodes.summary: Creates or updates Entity and EntityIsin rows for ISINs newly seen in an index snapshot, recording the earliest known link per ISIN.

nodes.name: reparse_stored_lists
nodes.summary: Re-parses previously stored raw constituent list blobs from object storage, used after parser fixes to re-derive snapshot data without re-fetching from the network.

nodes.name: parse_cdx
nodes.summary: Parses a Wayback Machine CDX API JSON response into a list of CdxCapture objects, raising CdxShapeError on malformed or unexpected structure.

nodes.name: run_boundaries
nodes.summary: From a list of CdxCapture objects, identifies consecutive runs sharing the same digest and returns only the boundary captures, deduplicating repeated snapshots.

nodes.name: ConstituentRow
nodes.summary: Pydantic model for a single row in an NSE Indices constituent CSV: company name, industry, ticker symbol, series, and ISIN.

nodes.name: ParsedList
nodes.summary: Result container for a parsed constituent list, holding the IndexCode enum, validated Constituent rows, and any RowIssue quarantine entries.

nodes.name: ListRejected
nodes.summary: Exception raised when an entire constituent list file is rejected due to an unrecoverable structural problem such as a missing header or zero valid rows.

nodes.name: index_for_url
nodes.summary: Maps a constituent list URL to its IndexCode enum value by matching the filename segment against a hardcoded lookup table, returning None for unknown URLs.

nodes.name: parse_constituent_list
nodes.summary: Parses a constituent CSV file's bytes into a ParsedList, auto-detecting the header, validating ISINs with the Luhn check, and quarantining rows with missing or malformed data.

nodes.name: StrictModel
nodes.summary: Base Pydantic model class configured with extra='forbid' so that any unexpected field from an upstream source raises a validation error immediately.

nodes.name: FakeClock
nodes.summary: Test-only fake clock that records sleep durations and advances a monotonic counter, enabling deterministic time-based assertions on PoliteClient throttling behavior.

nodes.name: base.py
nodes.summary: Defines the SQLAlchemy declarative Base and the ProvenanceMixin that attaches as_of, content_hash, source_url, extracted_by, model_version, and ingested_at columns to every store table, enforcing timezone-aware as_of before flush.
nodes.languageNotes: ProvenanceMixin uses a SQLAlchemy @validates event to reject naive datetimes before they reach the database, making the constraint ORM-level rather than DB-constraint-only.

nodes.name: models.py
nodes.summary: Central ORM model registry defining all store tables: financial facts, raw source files, entity/ISIN mapping, index snapshots and their quarantine, and NSE bhavcopy rows and quarantine, all inheriting ProvenanceMixin for append-only temporal semantics.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a _pg_enum helper to bind Python enums to named Postgres ENUM types, keeping SQL migrations deterministic.

nodes.name: pit.py
nodes.summary: Provides the complete set of point-in-time read functions for all stores; every function accepts an as_of parameter and enforces that only data visible at that wall-clock time is returned, preventing look-ahead bias.
nodes.languageNotes: All functions call require_aware on every datetime argument and use SQLAlchemy's .distinct().order_by() pattern to pick the latest-as-of version of each logical row without window functions.

nodes.name: timezones.py
nodes.summary: Exports require_aware, a one-function module that raises ValueError on any naive datetime, enforcing the system-wide rule that all timestamps must carry a timezone offset.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Empty package initializer that makes ingest/nse_bhavcopy a Python package; contains no public symbols.

nodes.name: adapters.py
nodes.summary: Implements the NseBhavcopy (HTTP) and NseBhavcopyDrop (drop-folder) adapters that fetch or read daily bhavcopy archive files, parse them, write accepted rows to NseBhavcopyRow, and route rejected rows to NseBhavcopyQuarantine.
nodes.languageNotes: The Tally dataclass accumulates run statistics and converts them to a RunResult; the two adapter classes share load_bhavcopy and reparse_stored_bhavcopy as module-level helpers.

nodes.name: env.py
nodes.summary: Alembic migration environment that reads the database URL from application config and wires SQLAlchemy metadata so schema diffs detect changes to all ORM models.

nodes.name: factories.py
nodes.summary: Provides the make_fact factory function that constructs a FinancialFact instance with sensible defaults and allows field-level overrides, used across database schema tests.

nodes.name: test_financial_facts_schema.py
nodes.summary: Tests that the financial_facts table enforces all schema constraints: Decimal precision, timezone-aware as_of in IST, Indian ISIN format, period ordering, XBRL element rules, duplicate prevention, and append-only immutability.

nodes.name: test_nse_bhavcopy_adapters.py
nodes.summary: Integration and unit tests for NseBhavcopy and NseBhavcopyDrop adapters, verifying correct row ingestion, quarantine routing, idempotency, and reparse behavior against fake HTTP responses and in-memory SQLite.

nodes.name: test_pit.py
nodes.summary: Tests the point-in-time query functions in core/db/pit.py, verifying that as_of filtering correctly excludes future data and returns the right latest-version row for financial facts and entity ISIN links.

nodes.name: ProvenanceMixin
nodes.summary: SQLAlchemy mixin that adds the six provenance columns (as_of, content_hash, source_url, extracted_by, model_version, ingested_at) to any table and validates that as_of is timezone-aware before each flush.

nodes.name: FinancialFact
nodes.summary: ORM model for a single XBRL financial line-item value, keyed by ISIN, consolidation type, fact kind, XBRL element, and fiscal period; stores Decimal value and unit with full provenance columns.

nodes.name: RawSourceFile
nodes.summary: ORM model tracking a raw source file saved to blob storage, keyed by content_hash; includes byte size, media type, fetch timestamp, and provenance columns enabling re-parse without re-download.

nodes.name: EntityIsin
nodes.summary: ORM model representing a dated link between an internal entity ID and an ISIN, recording the basis of the link (official filing, demerger, etc.) so ISIN-to-entity resolution is queryable at any past as_of.

nodes.name: IndexSnapshot
nodes.summary: ORM model for a single parsed index constituent list, carrying as_of, constituent count, quarantined row count, and rule_version so membership intervals can be computed without backfilling.

nodes.name: IndexSnapshotConstituent
nodes.summary: ORM model for one constituent row (ISIN, symbol, series, company name, industry) within an index snapshot, linked by snapshot_id foreign key.

nodes.name: IndexSnapshotQuarantine
nodes.summary: ORM model for a row from an index constituent list that could not be parsed or resolved, storing the raw row bytes, reason code, and detail so human reviewers can decide whether to accept or discard it.

nodes.name: NseBhavcopyRow
nodes.summary: ORM model for a single accepted NSE bhavcopy row with trade date, ISIN, symbol, series, OHLC prices, volume, turnover, trade count, and rule_version; all price fields stored as Decimal.

nodes.name: NseBhavcopyQuarantine
nodes.summary: ORM model for a rejected NSE bhavcopy row, storing the raw CSV row, reason code, detail message, and optional resolved ISIN and symbol for post-hoc review.

nodes.name: QuarantineEntry
nodes.summary: Dataclass returned by index quarantine review functions, pairing a quarantined snapshot row with an optional superseding snapshot ID; its needs_review property indicates whether the row still requires human action.

nodes.name: BhavcopyQuarantineEntry
nodes.summary: Dataclass returned by bhavcopy quarantine review functions, pairing a quarantined bhavcopy row with a boolean indicating whether a resolved row already exists for the same (source_url, isin, series) key.

nodes.name: Tally
nodes.summary: Mutable accumulator that tracks per-run statistics (raw files, accepted rows, quarantined rows, rejected files, skipped files, problems) and converts them to a RunResult via its result() method.

nodes.name: NseBhavcopy
nodes.summary: HTTP adapter that iterates over the NSE bhavcopy archive URL template for each missing trade date, downloads files via PoliteClient, stores raw bytes, and delegates parsing and DB persistence to load_bhavcopy.

nodes.name: NseBhavcopyDrop
nodes.summary: Drop-folder adapter that reads pre-downloaded bhavcopy files from a watched directory and ingests them through the same load_bhavcopy pipeline as the HTTP adapter, providing a fallback when NSE is inaccessible.

nodes.name: facts_as_of
nodes.summary: Returns the latest version of each (line_item, period_start, period_end) combination for a given ISIN and consolidation type as visible at as_of, using distinct-on-ordered-by to resolve multiple ingestion versions.

nodes.name: raw_source_files_as_of
nodes.summary: Returns all raw source file records ingested by a given extractor up to as_of, ordered newest-first, enabling reparse loops to iterate over historically known files.

nodes.name: entity_isin_earliest_links_as_of
nodes.summary: For a set of ISINs, returns the earliest-known entity link for each ISIN that was already established by as_of, giving a stable ISIN-to-entity mapping free of future reclassifications.

nodes.name: index_snapshots_as_of
nodes.summary: Retrieves the latest accepted snapshot per source URL for a given index code up to as_of, then bulk-fetches constituent ISINs for those snapshots, returning a list of Snapshot named tuples ready for membership computation.

nodes.name: index_snapshot_keys_as_of
nodes.summary: Returns a dict mapping (index_code, as_of) pairs to snapshot IDs for a given source URL and rule_version up to as_of, used to detect whether a file has already been loaded.

nodes.name: index_list_sources_settled_as_of
nodes.summary: Returns the set of source URLs that are fully settled (loaded with no outstanding quarantine-only records) for a given extractor and rule_version up to as_of, so the adapter skips already-complete files.

nodes.name: index_quarantine_review_as_of
nodes.summary: Builds a list of QuarantineEntry objects for all quarantined index snapshot rows up to as_of, joining against known accepted snapshots to determine which quarantine entries have been superseded and which still need human review.

nodes.name: bhavcopy_sources_settled_as_of
nodes.summary: Returns the set of bhavcopy source URLs that have at least one accepted row and no whole-file-level quarantine entry as of as_of, allowing the adapter to skip already-complete daily files.

nodes.name: bhavcopy_source_loaded_as_of
nodes.summary: Returns True when a specific bhavcopy source URL has been fully processed (either accepted rows or a file-level quarantine entry) by the given extractor and rule_version up to as_of, providing idempotency checks for the adapter.

nodes.name: bhavcopy_latest_trade_date_as_of
nodes.summary: Returns the most recent trade_date for which an accepted bhavcopy row exists for a given extractor up to as_of, used by the adapter to determine the starting point for backfill.

nodes.name: bhavcopy_rows_as_of
nodes.summary: Returns one NseBhavcopyRow per trade date for a given ISIN within a date range as visible at as_of, deduplicating multiple ingestion runs by keeping the latest as_of row per date.

nodes.name: symbol_to_isin_as_of
nodes.summary: Resolves a ticker symbol to its ISIN as of a given trade date and as_of timestamp by querying the bhavcopy row history, returning the most recent matching ISIN without allowing future assignments to bleed back.

nodes.name: bhavcopy_quarantine_review_as_of
nodes.summary: Builds a list of BhavcopyQuarantineEntry objects for all quarantined bhavcopy rows up to as_of, joining against accepted rows to flag which quarantine entries have been resolved and which still need human action.

nodes.name: require_aware
nodes.summary: Raises ValueError if the given datetime value has no UTC offset (is naive), enforcing the system-wide constraint that every timestamp must carry timezone information.

nodes.name: load_bhavcopy
nodes.summary: Parses a RawDocument into bhavcopy rows, skips already-loaded sources via bhavcopy_source_loaded_as_of, persists accepted NseBhavcopyRow objects and quarantined NseBhavcopyQuarantine objects in a single session, and updates the Tally.

nodes.name: reparse_stored_bhavcopy
nodes.summary: Iterates over all raw source files previously saved by this adapter (via raw_source_files_as_of), re-fetches their bytes from blob storage, and re-ingests them through load_bhavcopy ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã¢â‚¬Â enabling a parser fix to be applied without re-downloading.

nodes.name: make_fact
nodes.summary: Constructs a FinancialFact ORM instance with valid default field values (ISIN, consolidation, fact_kind, period dates, Decimal value, IST-aware as_of, content_hash) and merges any caller-supplied keyword overrides before returning.

nodes.name: blob.py
nodes.summary: Defines the BlobStore abstract interface and its S3-compatible concrete implementation (S3BlobStore) for write-once, content-hash-keyed object storage; provides a factory function for constructing S3 clients from application settings.

nodes.name: hashing.py
nodes.summary: Single pure function that computes a SHA-256 hex-digest string from bytes; used everywhere a content_hash is derived for blob keying and integrity checks.

nodes.name: membership.py
nodes.summary: Pure-function library for computing point-in-time Nifty index membership intervals from a sequence of dated constituent snapshots; correctly handles incomplete snapshots, simultaneous conflicts, and open-ended uncertainty without any I/O or stored state.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses dataclasses and frozensets throughout; no I/O, no database calls ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã¢â‚¬Â fully testable without fixtures.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Empty package initializer that makes ingest/nse_indices a Python package, containing no logic of its own.

nodes.name: conftest.py
nodes.summary: Pytest fixture module that provisions a fresh test Postgres database (running Alembic migrations up and down), an S3-backed blob store, and a transactional SQLAlchemy session that rolls back after each test.

nodes.name: fakes.py
nodes.summary: In-memory test doubles for the BlobStore interface: MemoryBlobStore stores blobs in a dict keyed by content_hash, and FailingBlobStore simulates a connection failure on put.

nodes.name: test_blob_s3.py
nodes.summary: Integration tests for S3BlobStore verifying round-trip put/get, idempotent puts, missing-key errors, immutability (object lock), and rejection of malformed hash keys against a live S3-compatible bucket.

nodes.name: test_compute_membership.py
nodes.summary: Unit tests for the membership computation library covering runs, uncertain edge periods, incomplete snapshots, re-entry, simultaneous-snapshot conflicts, and order-independence of input using property-based-style parameterization.

nodes.name: test_nse_indices_adapters.py
nodes.summary: Comprehensive integration test suite for the NSE Indices ingest adapters covering live and Wayback Machine paths, quarantine lifecycle, reparse semantics, blob integrity, gzip handling, drop-folder loading, and database constraints.

nodes.name: BlobIntegrityError
nodes.summary: Exception raised when bytes retrieved from blob storage do not match the expected content_hash, indicating storage corruption.

nodes.name: BlobStore
nodes.summary: Abstract base class defining the write-once blob storage interface with put, get, and exists operations keyed by SHA-256 content hash.

nodes.name: S3BlobStore
nodes.summary: Concrete BlobStore backed by an S3-compatible bucket; enforces write-once semantics by rejecting puts to existing keys, verifies integrity on get, and wraps boto3 ClientError codes into domain exceptions.

nodes.name: object_key
nodes.summary: Validates that a key is a 64-character lowercase hex string (SHA-256 digest) and raises ValueError for any other format.

nodes.name: s3_blob_store
nodes.summary: Factory that constructs an S3BlobStore from application Settings, configuring the boto3 client with endpoint, credentials, and a short connection timeout.

nodes.name: content_hash
nodes.summary: Computes and returns the SHA-256 hex digest of arbitrary bytes; the canonical key-derivation function for all blob storage throughout the system.

nodes.name: Snapshot
nodes.summary: Immutable dataclass representing a single point-in-time index constituent list with an observed_at timestamp, a frozenset of ISINs, and a completeness flag.

nodes.name: ObservedInterval
nodes.summary: Represents a continuous presence interval for one ISIN in an index, with nullable absent_before/absent_after flags indicating uncertainty at the boundaries.

nodes.name: Membership
nodes.summary: Result type returned by membership_on, carrying two disjoint frozensets: confirmed members and uncertain ISINs for a queried point in time.

nodes.name: ConflictingSnapshots
nodes.summary: Exception raised when two complete snapshots at the same observed_at timestamp disagree on their constituent sets.

nodes.name: _check_simultaneous
nodes.summary: Internal validator that groups snapshots by timestamp and raises ConflictingSnapshots if two complete snapshots at the same instant have differing ISIN sets.

nodes.name: observed_intervals
nodes.summary: Converts a sequence of Snapshot objects into a list of ObservedInterval records per ISIN, correctly handling incomplete snapshots (which do not end runs) and consecutive re-entries.

nodes.name: membership_on
nodes.summary: Point-in-time query over a list of ObservedIntervals that returns a Membership with confirmed members and uncertain ISINs for the given datetime, without look-ahead.

nodes.name: engine
nodes.summary: Session-scoped pytest fixture that drops and recreates the test database, runs Alembic migrations up/down/up to validate idempotency, and yields a live SQLAlchemy engine.

nodes.name: s3_store
nodes.summary: Session-scoped pytest fixture that constructs an S3BlobStore from settings and verifies the bucket is reachable, skipping all tests if the S3 endpoint is unavailable.

nodes.name: session
nodes.summary: Function-scoped pytest fixture that yields a SQLAlchemy Session within an outer transaction that is unconditionally rolled back after each test, ensuring isolation.

nodes.name: MemoryBlobStore
nodes.summary: In-memory BlobStore implementation that stores blobs in a dict keyed by content_hash; implements write-once semantics and used as the test double in all adapter unit tests.

nodes.name: FailingBlobStore
nodes.summary: Test double that overrides put to always raise ConnectionError, used to verify adapter resilience when blob storage is unavailable.

nodes.name: Web
nodes.summary: Fake HTTP transport for tests that routes requests to pre-registered in-memory page responses and CDX index data, recording all requests for assertion; wraps itself in an httpx.MockTransport.

nodes.name: _ctx
nodes.summary: Helper that constructs an AdapterContext for adapter tests, wiring together a DB session, a MemoryBlobStore, configurable settings, and a fixed clock.

nodes.name: test_live_lists_become_snapshots_members_and_entities
nodes.summary: Verifies that a successful live adapter run produces IndexSnapshot rows, correct membership via index_members_on, and EntityIsin rows for each constituent.

nodes.name: test_wayback_loads_run_boundaries_dated_by_capture_time
nodes.summary: Tests that WaybackIndexConstituents stores snapshots dated by Wayback capture timestamp (not fetch time) and that two captures produce correctly bounded membership intervals.

nodes.name: test_gzip_archived_capture_is_checked_as_transferred_and_stored_decoded
nodes.summary: Verifies that gzip-compressed Wayback captures are integrity-checked against the compressed bytes (as transferred) but stored decoded, matching the expected content_hash.

nodes.name: test_whole_file_quarantine_is_examined_again_only_after_a_rule_change
nodes.summary: Asserts that a file-level quarantine is not re-examined on subsequent runs with the same rule_version, but is re-evaluated once the rule_version advances via monkeypatch.

nodes.name: test_reparse_supersedes_an_incomplete_snapshot_from_stored_bytes_only
nodes.summary: Comprehensive test verifying that the reparse path re-derives a complete snapshot from previously stored blob bytes (never re-fetching), supersedes the old incomplete snapshot, and leaves other snapshots untouched.

nodes.name: test_row_quarantine_is_superseded_once_a_newer_snapshot_replaces_its_file
nodes.summary: Checks that a row-level quarantine entry is superseded (not deleted, only marked) when a reparse with a newer rule_version produces a complete snapshot from the same stored bytes.

nodes.name: test_dropped_capture_is_dated_by_its_sidecar_and_loaded_once
nodes.summary: Tests the drop-folder adapter path: a CSV file with a companion .sidecar.json is loaded exactly once with as_of derived from the sidecar, and a second run is idempotent.

nodes.name: config.py
nodes.summary: Central settings module that parses EQUITY_* environment variables and .env files into a typed Pydantic Settings object, including per-source enable switches and deployment-mode control.

nodes.name: sources.py
nodes.summary: Defines the SourceClass and DeploymentMode enums used throughout the system to classify data adapters and guard against scraping in commercial deployments.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package marker for the ingest module; currently empty aside from a package docstring.

nodes.name: __main__.py
nodes.summary: CLI entry point for the ingest subsystem; dispatches run, canary, and reparse subcommands to discovered adapters, enforces startup checks, and manages the SQLAlchemy session and blob store lifecycle.

nodes.name: base.py
nodes.summary: Defines the abstract Adapter and DropFolderAdapter base classes plus all supporting value types (RunResult, CanaryResult, RawDocument, AdapterContext), encoding the adapter protocol: save raw bytes to blob storage before parsing, respect source-class switches, and record full provenance.

nodes.name: registry.py
nodes.summary: Discovers all concrete Adapter subclasses in the ingest package at runtime, validates their declarations, and enforces startup rules including refusing to start in commercial mode if any web-scrape adapter is enabled.

nodes.name: test_config.py
nodes.summary: Tests that EQUITY_SOURCE_* environment variables are parsed into per-source switches correctly, that boolean parsing is strict, and that the .env file and environment variables interact as expected.

nodes.name: test_ingest_base.py
nodes.summary: Comprehensive tests for the Adapter base class and registry: verifies per-source and master scraping switches disable adapters correctly, that commercial-mode startup is refused when scraping is on, and that the CLI reparse subcommand dispatches to adapters.

nodes.name: test_raw_source_file.py
nodes.summary: Integration tests for the store_raw pathway and RawSourceFile database model: verifies blob-first write ordering, timezone-aware as_of enforcement, append-only constraints, point-in-time reads, and drop-folder ingestion.

nodes.name: Settings
nodes.summary: Pydantic BaseSettings class declaring all EQUITY_* environment variables including database URL, deployment mode, web-scraping master switch, per-source switches map, blob storage coordinates, and adapter-specific rate-limit parameters.

nodes.name: parse_source_switches
nodes.summary: Scans os.environ for EQUITY_SOURCE_<NAME>_ENABLED keys and returns a lowercase-name-to-bool mapping used as the Settings.source_switches dict.

nodes.name: get_settings
nodes.summary: Factory that merges a .env file into os.environ then constructs and returns a fully populated Settings instance.

nodes.name: SourceClass
nodes.summary: Enum of adapter source classes: official_api, official_archive, web_scrape, and manual_drop; used to gate adapters in commercial mode.

nodes.name: DeploymentMode
nodes.summary: Enum distinguishing personal from commercial deployment modes, determining whether web-scrape adapters are permitted.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Parses CLI arguments for run/canary/reparse subcommands, discovers adapters, enforces startup checks, opens a DB session and blob store, dispatches the requested operation, and exits with status 1 on any adapter failure.

nodes.name: Adapter
nodes.summary: Abstract base class for all data adapters; enforces the blob-first store_raw contract, manages disabled-reason logic from source-class switches, and declares the run/canary/reparse/ingest/check_shape interface that concrete adapters must implement.

nodes.name: DropFolderAdapter
nodes.summary: Adapter subclass for ingesting files from a configured local drop folder; reads a JSON sidecar for provenance metadata and refuses to proceed without one, ensuring no guessed as_of timestamps.

nodes.name: RunStatus
nodes.summary: Enum of adapter run outcomes: ok, disabled, and failed.

nodes.name: CanaryStatus
nodes.summary: Enum of canary check outcomes: ok, disabled, and failed.

nodes.name: RunResult
nodes.summary: Dataclass capturing the outcome of an adapter run: status, detail message, list of stored raw files, rows written, and quarantined count.

nodes.name: CanaryResult
nodes.summary: Dataclass capturing the outcome of an adapter canary check: status and detail message.

nodes.name: RawDocument

tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: README.md is the developer quickstart: Windows/PowerShell setup, the ingest adapter CLI commands, repository layout, and the database invariants enforced at the schema level. Reading it first gives you the map before you walk the territory ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã¢â‚¬Â you will understand why each directory exists before opening a single source file.

tour.title: The Non-Negotiable Rules
tour.description: CLAUDE.md is the master specification and the most important file in the repository. It defines three inviolable rules: R1 (code computes, LLMs narrate ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã¢â‚¬Â no model arithmetic), R2 (every table carries as_of and is append-only ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã¢â‚¬Â no backfill), and R3 (model outputs are hypotheses with code-evaluated conditions, never stored conclusions). Every architectural decision in subsequent steps traces back to one of these three rules.

tour.title: Temporal Data Model
tour.description: docs/temporal-model.md defines the time semantics that underpin every table in the system: the difference between event time (when something happened in the market), as_of (the timestamp used for point-in-time reads), and recorded_at (when the row was inserted). Understanding these three clocks is the prerequisite for writing any code that touches the database ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã¢â‚¬Â a query without an as_of filter violates R2 and introduces look-ahead bias, which is invisible in code review.

tour.title: ORM Models and Provenance
tour.description: core/db/models.py is the most imported file in the codebase (fan-in: 16) and defines the SQLAlchemy ORM models that back every store. The ProvenanceMixin is the direct implementation of R2: every table that inherits it gains as_of, content_hash, source_url, extracted_by, and model_version columns, making every row's lineage fully traceable. Key models include FinancialFact (XBRL line items), RawSourceFile (every fetched byte before parsing), IndexSnapshot with its constituents, and NseBhavRecord (daily equity prices).

tour.title: Configuration and Source Classification
tour.description: core/config.py loads all runtime settings from EQUITY_* environment variables using Pydantic's BaseSettings, making the system portable from a laptop to Kubernetes without code changes. core/sources.py defines the SourceClass enum ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã¢â‚¬Â official_api, official_archive, web_scrape, manual_drop ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã¢â‚¬Â which governs what data the system is permitted to ingest in each deployment mode. In commercial mode any web_scrape adapter causes a startup failure; the classification is stored with every row and enforced at read time.

tour.title: Point-in-Time Query Gateway
tour.description: core/db/pit.py is the sole read surface for all application data (fan-out: 34). Every function accepts an as_of parameter and filters WHERE as_of <= t, ensuring future data cannot bleed into any query. The architecture test enforces that no module outside pit.py may issue raw ORM queries against the provenance tables ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã¢â‚¬Â the gate is code, not convention. This is how R2 is enforced at the software boundary and how the system's replay semantics are guaranteed.

tour.title: Pure Deterministic Computation
tour.description: core/compute/membership.py is R1 made concrete: it computes index membership intervals from dated constituent lists using pure arithmetic, never storing the intervals, and never delegating to a model. Given snapshots known as_of time t, it derives which companies were in scope ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã¢â‚¬Â resolving ordering ambiguities as uncertain rather than guessing. core/compute/isin.py provides a Luhn-algorithm ISIN validator used in every parser. Both files have zero I/O, no side effects, and are fully property-tested per the rule that any function touching money or dates needs tests before it is done.

tour.title: Blob Store Abstraction
tour.description: core/blob.py defines the BlobStore abstract interface that every adapter uses to persist raw source bytes before parsing them. The concrete implementations (S3BlobStore for cloud, MinIOBlobStore for the laptop) are selected from config at startup ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã¢â‚¬Â adapter code never imports boto3 directly, keeping the interface swap-transparent. Objects are keyed by content_hash and treated as write-once immutable, so a parser bug can be fixed and all stored bytes can be reparsed without re-downloading anything from the exchange.

tour.title: Adapter Base and Registry
tour.description: ingest/base.py (fan-in: 8, fan-out: 28) defines the BaseAdapter contract that every source adapter must implement: run (fetch, save to blob, parse, write rows), canary (daily shape-change detection that fires before the main run), and reparse (re-derive rows from already-stored bytes without any network call). ingest/registry.py discovers all registered adapters at startup, checks source classes against the deployment mode, and raises on misconfiguration before any network call is made ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã¢â‚¬Â ensuring a misconfigured deployment fails loudly at launch, not silently mid-run.

tour.title: Polite HTTP Client
tour.description: ingest/http.py implements PoliteClient, the shared HTTP transport for all web_scrape adapters. It enforces per-host request throttling with a configurable delay, fetches and caches robots.txt per origin to honour disallow directives, and applies exponential backoff on transient server errors. If NSE or BSE blocks the client, the escalation path is a manual drop folder ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã¢â‚¬Â never browser impersonation, rotating proxies, or CAPTCHA work-arounds. The client identifies itself honestly and stops when it is stopped.

tour.title: Bhavcopy Parser Pipeline
tour.description: ingest/nse_bhavcopy/parser.py is a complete concrete adapter example: it unpacks the NSE bhavcopy ZIP archive for a trading day, validates each CSV row against a strict Pydantic schema (BhavRow), checks the ISIN with the Luhn validator from Step 7, and quarantines any malformed row with a structured rejection reason rather than failing the entire file. The raw ZIP bytes are saved to blob storage before any parsing begins, implementing the blob-first guarantee from Step 8. ingest/nse_bhavcopy/adapters.py wraps this parser in the BaseAdapter interface from Step 9.

tour.title: NSE Indices Multi-Source Adapter
tour.description: ingest/nse_indices/adapters.py demonstrates the layered resilience strategy for unreliable sources. The LiveAdapter hits the live NSE Indices endpoint and is classified web_scrape; the DropFolderAdapter reads manually downloaded files and is classified manual_drop; the WaybackAdapter fetches historical constituent CSVs from the Internet Archive with as_of set to the Wayback capture timestamp, not the fetch time. All three adapters produce the same row shape and route through the same parser, so the system assembles a consistent view of index history from whatever combination of sources was available ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã¢â‚¬Â a direct implementation of R2's insistence that as_of always reflects when data was public.
